_meta.purpose: Realistic (NOT hand-picked-adversarial) flow test for the integrated router. Natural questions a user might ask over the promoted-overlay domain, spanning branches, shuffled. gold_branch = intended branch; reflective covers both verified (v1) and extended (v2) — routing to either is correct for a reflective question.
_meta.note: distinct from routing_v1 pilot cases, which were deliberately boundary-adversarial.
